name: blast-radius-reviewer
description: Reviews a code diff you paste (git diff, PR .patch/.diff or diff -u) for what could break OUTSIDE the diff: callers of removed or changed functions, other clients reading a removed field, existing rows hit by a migration, renamed env vars and config keys, a rule that lives in a second place, changed defaults, dependency bumps, workers that restart separately, tests, dashboards, generated code and deleted files. Twelve risk probes fire in code; the model only judges each one. For every risk it gives the reason, the evidence rung, a grep command built from a token in your diff and the one fact the change's safety hangs on, then a verdict (block, review, or nothing found in what you pasted; never 'safe to merge'). Paste grep output or callers' code after 'context:' to clear or confirm items. It reads only what you paste, never invents a caller or file, runs nothing and sends nothing. Not for style review, bugs inside the diff, writing code or security audits.

skills.name: What could this diff break?
skills.description: Places outside a pasted diff that could break (callers, clients, stored data, config, rules living twice, defaults, dependencies, rollout, tests, observability, generated code, deletions), each with why, a grep check and its evidence rung, plus the one safety fact and a block/review/nothing-found verdict.
examples: What could break? <paste a git diff>
Blast radius of this change + here's the grep output for `format_date`: <diff> context: <grep output>
Review this migration for what it could break: <paste the migration diff>
